summary: Architectural implementation plan for AI Minecraft 3D Reconstruction Engine (IMAGE → 3D ARCHITECTURAL MODEL → VOXEL MAPPING & ORIENTATION SOLVER → VALIDATED SCHEMATIC). Defines full-stack Express + Vite React architecture, Three.js instanced block renderer, Minecraft block registry with block states, Gemini vision multimodal pipeline, interactive 3D editor/workbench, layer-by-layer schematic slicer, and multi-format exporters (.schem, .litematic, JSON, layer blueprints).
